QuestInfo.name: [FriendStory] You Are My Fate 1
QuestInfo.1: Speak with Stan the Homeroom Teacher in the Staff Lounge, Ericsson the Security Guard at the front gates of the Old Shinsoo School building, Orchid in the Second Floor Classroom, and Irena in the Third Floor Classroom.
QuestInfo.2: Stan the Homeroom Teacher, Ericsson the Security Guard, Orchid, and Irena all agree that Ms. Hilla and Mr. Magnus are quite possibly the worst match imaginable.
